name: kanonix
description: Algeria's Official Journal since 1962, in Arabic and French: search laws, decrees and orders, read their articles, see how they were amended or repealed, and follow texts in preparation. Every answer links to the text on Kanonix and to the Journal issue that published it.

interface.longDescription: Kanonix opens the whole Official Journal of the Algerian Republic since 1962: more than 220,000 texts in Arabic and French - laws, ordinances, decrees and orders. Ask a question and Kanonix finds the text and the article, says whether it was amended or repealed, and links every answer to the text's page and to the Journal issue that published it. It also follows texts announced but not yet published (bills before Parliament). All tools are read-only; no account is needed to read. Answers are legal information, not legal advice.
capabilities: Search Algerian laws, decrees and orders since 1962, in Arabic and French
Read an article or a whole text, with a link to its official publication
Show what amended, completed or repealed a text
Follow texts in preparation before they reach the Official Journal
